# Script API reference

<!-- Generated by scripts/gen-docs.mjs from src/editor/scriptTypes.ts. Do not edit by hand: run `node scripts/gen-docs.mjs`. -->

Scripts are JavaScript modules that export an object; the editor type-checks them against these declarations (the same ones listed here).

```js
/** @type {import('engine').Script} */
export default {
  params: { speed: 4 },
  update(ctx, dt) {
    ctx.object.position.x += ctx.input.getAxis('MoveX') * ctx.params.speed * dt
  },
}
```

## Stability

Everything on this page is the public script API. From version 1.0 it follows semantic versioning: members are only removed or changed in a major release, and new members can arrive in any minor release. Anything not listed here (for example `ctx.engine`, which exposes engine internals) can change at any time.

Scripts also get `THREE` (three.js) and `helpers` (`damp`, `dampAngle`, `moveTowards`, `teleport`) as globals.

## Script

What a script file exports. Every hook is optional.

- **`params`** — `params?: P`
  Defaults for inspector fields; the type comes from the value ('#rrggbb' = color).
- **`start`** — `start?(ctx: Context<P>): void`
- **`fixedUpdate`** — `fixedUpdate?(ctx: Context<P>, dt: number): void`
  Fixed 60 Hz step, before physics.
- **`update`** — `update?(ctx: Context<P>, dt: number): void`
- **`lateUpdate`** — `lateUpdate?(ctx: Context<P>, dt: number): void`
  After update (cameras, followers).
- **`onCollisionEnter`** — `onCollisionEnter?(ctx: Context<P>, other: Handle): void`
- **`onCollisionExit`** — `onCollisionExit?(ctx: Context<P>, other: Handle): void`
- **`onDestroy`** — `onDestroy?(ctx: Context<P>): void`

## Context

The `ctx` every hook receives: the entity it runs on plus the engine services. Also has every member of [Handle](#handle).

- **`params`** — `readonly params: P`
  Inspector-editable values declared in params.
- **`input`** — `readonly input: Input`
- **`time`** — `readonly time: Time`
- **`state`** — `readonly state: Record<string, any>`
  Per-instance scratch space.
- **`globals`** — `readonly globals: Record<string, any>`
  Shared by every script in the scene.
- **`hud`** — `readonly hud: Hud`
- **`ui`** — `readonly ui: Ui`
- **`physics`** — `readonly physics: Physics`
- **`sound`** — `readonly sound: Sound`
- **`audio`** — `readonly audio: AudioSource | undefined`
- **`animation`** — `readonly animation: Animation | undefined`
- **`particles`** — `readonly particles: Particles | undefined`
  Present when the entity has a Particle Emitter.
- **`sprite`** — `readonly sprite: { flipX: boolean; frame: number; fps: number; color: string } | undefined`
  Present when the entity has a Sprite: flipX, frame, fps (sheet animation) and color.
- **`nav`** — `readonly nav: Nav`
  Pathfinding over the scene's static colliders, around moving bodies.
- **`music`** — `readonly music: { play(asset: string, options?: { fade?: number; volume?: number; loop?: boolean }): void stop(fade?: number): void readonly current: string | null }`
  Background music that keeps playing (or cross-fades) across scenes.
- **`volume`** — `readonly volume: { set(group: 'master' | 'music' | 'sfx', value: number): void; get(group: 'master' | 'music' | 'sfx'): number }`
  Volume groups (0..1), remembered for the player: ctx.volume.set('music', 0.5).
- **`sceneName`** — `readonly sceneName: string`
- **`engine`** — `readonly engine: any`
- **`find`** — `find(name: string): Handle | undefined`
- **`spawn`** — `spawn(prefab: string, options?: { position?: Vec3Like; rotation?: Vec3Like; parent?: Handle }): Handle | undefined`
- **`loadScene`** — `loadScene(name: string): void`
- **`destroy`** — `destroy(target?: Handle): void`
- **`after`** — `after(seconds: number, fn: () => void): Timer`
  Calls fn once after some seconds of game time. Cancelled if this entity is destroyed.
- **`every`** — `every(seconds: number, fn: () => void): Timer`
  Calls fn every few seconds until cancelled or this entity is destroyed.
- **`tween`** — `tween<T extends object>(target: T, to: Partial<Record<keyof T, number>>, duration: number, options?: TweenOptions): Timer`
  Animates numeric properties: ctx.tween(ctx.object.position, { y: 3 }, 0.5, { ease: 'backOut' })
- **`on`** — `on(name: string, fn: (data: any) => void): () => void`
  Listens for an event from any script; returns a function that stops listening.
- **`emit`** — `emit(name: string, data?: unknown): void`
  Sends an event to every listener right away, e.g. ctx.emit('damage', { target: other, amount: 1 }).
- **`save`** — `save(key: string, value: unknown): void`
  Stores a JSON value that survives reloads (high scores, progress).
- **`load`** — `load<T>(key: string, fallback: T): T`
- **`deleteSave`** — `deleteSave(key: string): void`
- **`log`** — `log(...args: unknown[]): void`
- **`warn`** — `warn(...args: unknown[]): void`
- **`error`** — `error(...args: unknown[]): void`

## Handle

An entity as scripts see it (also what `find`, `spawn` and collision hooks give you).

- **`entity`** — `readonly entity: number`
- **`name`** — `readonly name: string`
- **`object`** — `readonly object: T3.Object3D`
- **`body`** — `readonly body: RigidBody | undefined`
  Rigid body state (position, velocity, grounded...) when the entity has one.

## RigidBody

`ctx.body`, when the entity has a Rigid Body.

- **`position`** — `position: T3.Vector3`
- **`velocity`** — `velocity: T3.Vector3`
- **`rotation`** — `rotation: T3.Quaternion`
- **`grounded`** — `grounded: boolean`
- **`gravityScale`** — `gravityScale: number`
- **`kinematic`** — `kinematic: boolean`
- **`character`** — `character: boolean`

## Input

`ctx.input`: keyboard, mouse, gamepad and touch, through the actions and axes in Project Settings.

- **`isDown`** — `isDown(codes: string | string[]): boolean`
  KeyboardEvent.code ('KeyW', 'Space'), 'Mouse0'..'Mouse2' or 'GamepadA' etc.
- **`wasPressed`** — `wasPressed(codes: string | string[]): boolean`
- **`wasReleased`** — `wasReleased(codes: string | string[]): boolean`
- **`axis`** — `axis(negative: string | string[], positive: string | string[]): number`
  -1, 0 or 1.
- **`bind`** — `bind(action: string, codes: string[]): void`
- **`action`** — `action(name: string): boolean`
  Held: a named action from Project Settings → Input (Jump, Sprint, Fire, Interact...).
- **`actionPressed`** — `actionPressed(name: string): boolean`
- **`actionReleased`** — `actionReleased(name: string): boolean`
- **`hasAction`** — `hasAction(name: string): boolean`
- **`getAxis`** — `getAxis(name: string): number`
  -1..1 from a named axis in Project Settings → Input (MoveX, MoveY, LookX, LookY): keys, gamepad and touch combined.
- **`requestPointerLock`** — `requestPointerLock(): void`
- **`exitPointerLock`** — `exitPointerLock(): void`
- **`pointer`** — `readonly pointer: { x: number; y: number; dx: number; dy: number; wheel: number; locked: boolean }`
- **`gamepad`** — `readonly gamepad: { connected: boolean; axes: [number, number, number, number] }`

## Time

`ctx.time`.

- **`elapsed`** — `readonly elapsed: number`
  Seconds since the scene started (scaled).
- **`delta`** — `readonly delta: number`
- **`fixedDelta`** — `readonly fixedDelta: number`
- **`frame`** — `readonly frame: number`
- **`scale`** — `scale: number`

## Physics

`ctx.physics`: queries, forces and joints.

- **`raycast`** — `raycast(origin: T3.Vector3, direction: T3.Vector3, maxDistance?: number, options?: { triggers?: boolean; ignoreSelf?: boolean }): PhysicsHit | null`
- **`applyImpulse`** — `applyImpulse(target: Handle, impulse: T3.Vector3): void`
- **`addForce`** — `addForce(target: Handle, force: T3.Vector3): void`
  Pushes a dynamic body for this step; call it every fixedUpdate for a steady push.
- **`addTorque`** — `addTorque(target: Handle, torque: T3.Vector3): void`
  Spins a dynamic body for this step; call it every fixedUpdate.
- **`applyTorqueImpulse`** — `applyTorqueImpulse(target: Handle, impulse: T3.Vector3): void`
- **`angularVelocity`** — `angularVelocity(target: Handle): T3.Vector3`
  Radians per second around each world axis.
- **`setAngularVelocity`** — `setAngularVelocity(target: Handle, velocity: T3.Vector3): void`
- **`overlap`** — `overlap(center: T3.Vector3, size: number | T3.Vector3, options?: { triggers?: boolean; ignoreSelf?: boolean }): Handle[]`
  Entities touching a sphere (radius) or box (half extents) at a point.
- **`sphereCast`** — `sphereCast(origin: T3.Vector3, radius: number, direction: T3.Vector3, maxDistance?: number, options?: { triggers?: boolean; ignoreSelf?: boolean }): PhysicsHit | null`
  A raycast with thickness.
- **`connect`** — `connect(body: Handle, target: Handle | null, options?: JointOptions): void`
  Joins body's rigid body to target's (or a fixed point in the world when null), from where they are now. Replaces any joint body already has.
- **`disconnect`** — `disconnect(body: Handle): void`
  Removes body's joint.

## PhysicsHit

A raycast or sphere-cast result.

- **`handle`** — `handle: Handle`
- **`point`** — `point: T3.Vector3`
- **`normal`** — `normal: T3.Vector3`
- **`distance`** — `distance: number`

## JointOptions

Options for `ctx.physics.connect`; the same fields as the Joint component.

- **`type`** — `type?: 'fixed' | 'hinge' | 'ball' | 'slider' | 'spring'`
  Default 'fixed'.
- **`anchor`** — `anchor?: Vec3Like`
  Joint point relative to body (local units). Default its origin.
- **`axis`** — `axis?: Vec3Like`
  Hinge/slider axis in body's local space. Default up.
- **`limits`** — `limits?: [number, number] | null`
  Hinge: degrees. Slider: meters.
- **`restLength`** — `restLength?: number`
  Spring: rest length in meters; -1 (default) = the current distance.
- **`stiffness`** — `stiffness?: number`
- **`damping`** — `damping?: number`
- **`motorSpeed`** — `motorSpeed?: number`
  Hinge (degrees/s) or slider (m/s).
- **`motorStrength`** — `motorStrength?: number`

## Nav

`ctx.nav`: pathfinding over the scene.

- **`findPath`** — `findPath(from: Vec3Like, to: Vec3Like): T3.Vector3[] | null`
  Walkable waypoints between two points, or null if unreachable. The grid is baked from static colliders on first use.
- **`moveTo`** — `moveTo(target: Vec3Like | Handle, options?: { speed?: number; stoppingDistance?: number; face?: boolean }): boolean`
  Walks this entity to a point, or keeps following a moving entity, steering around moving bodies on the way. Returns false if there's no path.
- **`stop`** — `stop(): void`
- **`moving`** — `readonly moving: boolean`
- **`path`** — `readonly path: readonly T3.Vector3[]`
- **`randomPoint`** — `randomPoint(radius?: number): T3.Vector3 | null`
  A random walkable point, optionally within radius of this entity.

## Animation

`ctx.animation`, when the entity has a Model.

- **`play`** — `play(clip: string, options?: { fade?: number; loop?: boolean; speed?: number }): void`
  Plays a clip, or enters a state-machine state by name.
- **`stop`** — `stop(fade?: number): void`
- **`set`** — `set(param: string, value: number | boolean): void`
  Sets a state-machine parameter used by transition conditions and blends.
- **`get`** — `get(param: string): number | boolean | undefined`
- **`trigger`** — `trigger(name: string): void`
  One-shot parameter, true until a transition that checks it fires.
- **`clips`** — `readonly clips: string[]`
- **`current`** — `readonly current: string | null`

## Particles

`ctx.particles`, when the entity has a Particle Emitter.

- **`play`** — `play(): void`
  Restarts the emitter: fires its burst and emits for its duration.
- **`stop`** — `stop(): void`
  Stops emitting; live particles finish their lifetime.
- **`burst`** — `burst(count?: number): void`
  Emits count particles at once (default: the emitter's burst count).
- **`clear`** — `clear(): void`
  Removes every live particle.
- **`emitting`** — `readonly emitting: boolean`
- **`count`** — `readonly count: number`
  Live particles.

## Sound

`ctx.sound`: one-shot sounds and a small synth.

- **`play`** — `play(asset: string, options?: { volume?: number; at?: Vec3Like }): void`
  One-shot from an audio asset name; at makes it 3D.
- **`tone`** — `tone(frequency: number, duration?: number, options?: { type?: 'sine' | 'square' | 'sawtooth' | 'triangle'; volume?: number; delay?: number }): void`

## AudioSource

`ctx.audio`, when the entity has an Audio Source.

- **`play`** — `play(): void`
- **`stop`** — `stop(): void`
- **`setVolume`** — `setVolume(volume: number): void`
- **`playing`** — `readonly playing: boolean`

## Ui

`ctx.ui`: screen UI built from scripts.

- **`text`** — `text(id: string, text: string | number, style?: UiStyle): void`
- **`button`** — `button(id: string, label: string, onClick: () => void, style?: UiStyle): void`
- **`bar`** — `bar(id: string, value: number, style?: UiStyle & { label?: string; fill?: string }): void`
  value is 0..1
- **`label`** — `label(id: string, text: string | number, target: Handle, style?: { offsetY?: number; size?: number; color?: string }): void`
  Text that follows an entity in the world.
- **`remove`** — `remove(id: string): void`
- **`clear`** — `clear(): void`

## UiStyle

Placement and look of `ctx.ui` elements.

- **`anchor`** — `anchor?: Anchor`
- **`x`** — `x?: number`
- **`y`** — `y?: number`
- **`size`** — `size?: number`
- **`color`** — `color?: string`
- **`background`** — `background?: string`
- **`width`** — `width?: number`

## Hud

`ctx.hud`: the stat cards and messages at the top of the screen.

- **`set`** — `set(key: string, value: string | number): void`
- **`remove`** — `remove(key: string): void`
- **`message`** — `message(text: string | null): void`

## Timer

What `after` and `every` return.

- **`cancel`** — `cancel(): void`
- **`done`** — `readonly done: boolean`

## TweenOptions

Options for `ctx.tween`.

- **`ease`** — `ease?: Ease`
- **`delay`** — `delay?: number`
- **`loop`** — `loop?: boolean`
- **`yoyo`** — `yoyo?: boolean`
  With loop: go back and forth.
- **`onComplete`** — `onComplete?: () => void`

## Vec3Like

Any `{ x, y, z }`, including three.js vectors.

- **`x`** — `x: number`
- **`y`** — `y: number`
- **`z`** — `z: number`
